description: All Too Well. Oh gosh, I know you all love the ten minute version, but the original is where my heart lives. I wrote this when I was barely 21 and so completely heartbroken that the only thing that made sense was singing it out. The scarf was real, by the way — and yes, he still has it 😉🫶 It's messy and sad and I still cry every single time I perform it. Five stars because some songs just carve out a room in you and stay.
